title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Reversal of Points on Refunded Merchandise
content:
**1. Former opening clause.** The clause "when a return refund is issued for merchandise of an order that earned points, the points earned on the refunded merchandise are reversed" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**2. Reversed spend.** The reversed spend is the merchandise amount refunded for that order on that return, after any restocking fee withheld. It excludes refunded shipping fees, sales tax and any part originally paid with Marlowe Rewards Notes.

**3. Former multiplier clause.** The clause "the reversal uses the multiplier recorded on the order's original earning entry, never the multiplier of the tier held today, and is rounded the same way as earning" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Membership status.** A reversal is posted only while the membership is in status active or suspended.

**5. One reversal per return and order.** Only one reversal entry is posted for each combination of return and order.

**6. Orders that never earned.** When the order never earned, so that no earning entry exists for it, nothing is reversed.

**7. Negative balance.** A reversal may take the points balance below zero. Later earnings offset the deficit first.

**8. Effect on tier.** A reversal reduces calendar-year qualifying spend but never changes the tier held during the year. Tiers move down only at the annual review.

**9. Rewards Notes already issued.** A Marlowe Rewards Note already issued is never withdrawn because of a later reversal.

## Reading clauses 4 to 9 (hypothetical member)

| Situation | Effect |
|---|---|
| The membership is suspended and a return of an earning order is refunded | A reversal may post (clause 4) |
| A second refund is issued on the same return and order after a reversal was posted | No second reversal entry (clause 5) |
| The refunded order shows no earning entry | Nothing is reversed (clause 6) |
| The balance is 40 points and the reversal is 90 points | The balance becomes minus 50, and the next earnings fill that deficit first (clause 7) |
| The member holds Marlowe Rewards Gold and the reversal lowers this year's qualifying spend below the Gold threshold | The member keeps Gold for the year (clause 8) |
| A note was issued from these points last month | The note stands (clause 9) |

superseded_clauses: The reversal uses the `tier_multiplier_applied` recorded on the order's original earning row, never the multiplier of the tier held today, and is rounded the same way as earning.
When a return refund is issued for merchandise of an order that earned points, the points earned on the refunded merchandise are reversed.
